approval-authority-fixtures.cause: Intended shared-approval operator was not explicitly allowlisted; one owner-provenance actor mismatched. Detached fake work needed cleanup once dispatch became reachable.
approval-authority-fixtures.acceptance: L1 and synthetic L4 approval, execution, replay and outbox verification

mutation-origin-fixtures.cause: Browser mutation fixtures omitted same-origin Origin required by current production CSRF checks.

dashboard-tenant-fixtures.cause: Dashboard org is self-hosted; fixture incorrectly equated tenant org with authenticated thread owner.

verified-access-fixtures.cause: Worker now strips unverified Access email headers; fixtures used a header without a signed JWT/audience. Repaired with real local RS256 verification, retaining forged-header denials.

dashboard-route-fixtures.cause: Fixtures requested Tasks while asserting Threads/Work composer, and expected obsolete empty-state text.

browser-only-state-during-ssr.cause: CuratedMcpConnections read window.location during render without a browser. Origin lookup now occurs on OAuth click.

artifact-ownership-fixture.cause: Artifact fixture mocked auth but omitted owner identity and ownership metadata now required before serving evidence.

sandbox-egress-fixture.cause: Sandbox fake omitted approveHarnessEgress, so it failed before the intended terminal repository-scope error.
sandbox-egress-fixture.acceptance: L1/L4 preflight and retry safety contracts

usage-clock-fixture.cause: Route uses current date but fixture records were fixed to October 2. Pin Date.now for the intended aggregation date.
usage-clock-fixture.acceptance: L1 usage regression; no live-provider evidence

offline-inspection-environment.cause: lsof exits 1 with can't stat() mqueue filesystem /dev/mqueue and 'Output information may be incomplete.' Offline backup correctly fails closed. No guard changed and no test skipped.
offline-inspection-environment.acceptance: Outside live coworker L1/L4 slice; complete repository gate remains red
